decision.reason: [ev-95905bec04ab] is only a changelog line saying "chore: update dependencies" with a link to PR #4624. It doesn't name which dependencies changed, their before/after versions, or any operational effect. The line sits under a BREAKING CHANGES › What's Changed heading, but nothing says what breaks or who is exposed. To write the subject, change, applicability and consequence, we'd need the PR's dependency diff (go.mod, chart or image changes) or a release note that names the actual change.
